speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing sudden-onset lower back pain that radiates down your leg. To better evaluate this, how would you describe the nature of the pain—is it sharp, burning, or electric, and does it reach below your knee?

speaker: Patient
text: 26-year-old woman. The patient reports exercising in the gym several hours ago when she suddenly felt a sharp pain in her lower back. She describes the pain as radiating down the side of her leg and into her foot.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Lumbar Herniated Disc.

The description of sudden onset sharp pain while exercising, radiating from the lower back into the foot, is classic for a herniated disc. Before we confirm, can you tell me if you have any numbness, tingling, or weakness in that leg or foot?
